title: NestKAN: A Nested Kolmogorov–Arnold Model for Discrete-Time Survival Data: reproducibility package

creators.name: T. T., Simhaa
creators.affiliation: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

creators.name: Kattumannil, Sudheesh Kumar
creators.affiliation: Applied Statistics Unit, Indian Statistical Institute, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

description: Code for NestKAN, a discrete-time hazard model that nests the grouped Cox model, an additive spline model and a gated Kolmogorov–Arnold network surface. Includes the dkan library, all benchmark, simulation, interpretability and robustness analysis scripts, and the pre-registration protocols (v5–v8). Code only; third-party datasets are not redistributed.
